steps.title: Inspect current crash symptoms
steps.description: Analyze app components and layouts to find potential sources of runtime crashes on application launch.

steps.title: Remove crash-prone legacy styles from activity_main.xml
steps.description: Remove legacy styles like '?android:attr/buttonStyleSmall' from the tab buttons which often cause theme inflation exceptions on modern Android versions.

steps.title: Refine Tab Buttons styling
steps.description: Replace legacy styled attributes with explicit padding and text sizes to ensure visual and functional compatibility.

steps.title: Strip external unused dependency in build.gradle
steps.description: Remove nanohttpd library implementation from app level build.gradle to ensure strict adherence to offline SDK-only builds and resolve any runtime classloader crash.

steps.title: Ensure view IDs alignment in MainActivity.java
steps.description: Ensure the ID bindings for digits, operators, and game controls are safe and verified to prevent NullPointerExceptions during setup.

steps.title: Validate manifest settings
steps.description: Confirm package name, target SDK compliance, and launcher activity configuration in AndroidManifest.xml.

steps.title: Check Java 8 compatibility configuration
steps.description: Ensure that both build.gradle and MainActivity.java compile without advanced platform features or lambda errors.

steps.title: Review asset and metadata integrity
steps.description: Verify app-meta.json configurations to ensure consistency across the built-steps environment.

steps.title: Perform visual inspection on layout
steps.description: Ensure layouts and widgets have correct dimensions and orientation attributes.

steps.title: Building Magic Math Calculator
steps.description: Compile standard code base and generate executable debug package.
